Experience the divine power of Bismillah, a soul-stirring live performance by Daler Mehndi from the Ruh Se Rab Tak series.
A heartfelt invocation that celebrates faith, gratitude, and the eternal connection between the soul and the Supreme. Let this spiritual rendition guide you towards peace, positivity, and inner awakening.

Track: Bismillah (Live)
Series: Ruh Se Rab Tak – Soul To Supreme
